How SkillSpark works

Three simple steps. No pressure.

1

Pick one skill

Choose just one. Focus beats trying everything at once.

2

Follow the weekly plan

Each week has 3 small tasks. Tick them off and watch your progress bar grow.

3

Make something small

By week 4 you create your first real project to be proud of.

5 rules for beginners

  • Start tinyEven 10 minutes counts. Showing up matters more than long sessions.
  • Same time dailyLink it to a habit, like right after breakfast.
  • Expect bad first triesEveryone starts clumsy. That is how learning works.
  • Make, don't just watchSpend more time doing than watching tutorials.
  • Share your workShow a friend or family member each week.

Preface 📖

Many people want to learn a new skill such as coding, drawing, music or public speaking, but they do not know where to start. Most courses are long, confusing or expensive. SkillSpark is a beginner-friendly website that turns any skill into a simple 30-day plan with small tasks, a final project and a certificate.

This website was designed and built as a college project to show how HTML, CSS and JavaScript can work together to make a complete, useful and good-looking web application that runs on both mobile and desktop.

Objectives

  • Make learning a new skill simple with a clear 30-day plan.
  • Show course fees clearly for every skill.
  • Provide an online admission form with proper validation.
  • Let students practise with fun mini-games and earn XP.
  • Give certificates that can be searched by skill name, student name or ID.
  • Work well on any screen, with light and dark themes.

Technologies used

HTML5CSS3JavaScriptCanvas APIWeb StorageGoogle Fonts

Acknowledgement

I would like to sincerely thank my project guide and my college for their guidance, support and encouragement while I made this project. I also thank my family and friends for their help and feedback.

— Your Name

← IndexNext: Home →

Conclusion 🏁

SkillSpark shows that a clear, simple plan can make learning a new skill less scary for beginners. The website brings courses, fees, admission, games, students and certificates together in one easy place. It was built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, so it is light, fast and works on mobile and desktop.

Limitations

  • Data is saved only in the browser, not on a server.
  • The student list uses sample records for demonstration.
  • There is no real payment or certificate verification yet.

Future scope

  • User login and a real database.
  • Online payment for course fees.
  • Video lessons and live classes.
  • A mobile app and more skills.
  • Certificate verification with a QR code.

References

  • MDN Web Docs: developer.mozilla.org
  • W3Schools: www.w3schools.com
  • Google Fonts: fonts.google.com

1. PREFACE

Many people want to learn a new skill such as coding, drawing, music or public speaking, but they may not know where to begin. SkillSpark is designed as a beginner-friendly website that presents learning as a simple 30-day journey. It divides a skill into small weekly sections, daily practice tasks and a final project.

The website has been developed as a college project to demonstrate how HTML, CSS and JavaScript can be combined to create an interactive web application. The layout is designed to work on mobile phones as well as desktop screens.

Objectives of the Project

  • To make starting a new skill easier through a clear 30-day learning plan.
  • To display course categories and monthly fee information.
  • To provide an online admission form with input validation.
  • To include learning games that make practice more engaging.
  • To provide certificate browsing and certificate search features.
  • To support responsive layouts and light/dark appearance themes.

Acknowledgement

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to my project guide and the faculty of SGAD College Government Tarntaran College for their guidance and support. I also thank my family and friends for their encouragement and feedback during the development of this project.

Submitted by:

2. INTRODUCTION AND PROJECT OBJECTIVES

Project Name: SkillSpark – A 30-Day Skill Learning Website

Project Idea: SkillSpark helps beginners explore a skill, follow a four-week plan, complete practice tasks and work towards a small final project. The website brings learning plans, fee information, admission, games, student information and certificates into one interface.

Main Learning Model

Step 1Choose a skill
Step 2Follow the weekly plan
Step 3Complete a small project

The plan is organised into four weeks. Each week contains three short tasks, giving a total of 12 tasks. The website encourages learners to spend around 20 minutes per day and finish with a practical project.

Skill Categories

CategoryNumber of skills

The website contains skill entries across categories.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

3. HOME PAGE: COURSES AND FEES

The Home page introduces SkillSpark and allows visitors to explore the available skills. Users can filter the skill cards by category, select a skill and view its four-week learning roadmap. The page also contains a monthly fee section, certificate preview information and a short explanation of how the website works.

Skill Catalogue

SkillCategory

Monthly Fee Information

SkillMonthly fee

Fees are shown per month for each skill in the website.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

4. ADMISSION MODULE

The Admission page explains the joining process and displays sample batch information. It includes an online admission form where a learner can enter personal and course-related details.

Fields available in the admission form

  • Student full name and age.
  • Parent or guardian name (requested if the student is under 18).
  • Phone number, email address and city.
  • Skill selection and preferred batch (Morning, Evening or Weekend).
  • Confirmation checkbox for the submitted details and admission terms.

When a skill is selected, the page displays its monthly fee. The form checks required information and can show an application receipt with an Admission ID. The website notes that applications are saved on the current device only.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

5. LEARNING GAMES

The Games page contains interactive mini-games intended to help learners practise AI tools and drawing concepts. Players answer questions or complete small activities and can earn experience points (XP). This adds a playful practice area to the learning website.

Examples of game activities include matching a task with a suitable AI tool and choosing a more detailed prompt to get a better result. The games are intended as practice and awareness activities rather than formal examinations.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

6. STUDENTS MODULE

The Students page displays a list of students who have taken admission. It includes a search field that can be used to search by student name or city, along with category filters. The website hides contact details to protect privacy and identifies the displayed sample student names as demonstration data.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

7. CERTIFICATES

The website includes a certificate section where visitors can browse sample certificates associated with skills. The certificate catalogue displays the certificate title, course duration, completion requirement and final project.

The website describes a completion process based on finishing all 12 tasks and completing the Week 4 final project. The certificate search page allows a learner to search using a full name or Admission ID. A sample certificate preview can also be opened and downloaded.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

8. ABOUT US

SkillSpark is presented as a beginner-focused learning platform. Its aim is to make skill learning simple, approachable and organised. The About page explains the four-step process: choose a skill, apply for admission, complete the weekly tasks, and submit the final project.

Main benefits shown on the About page

  • Beginner-friendly four-week learning plans.
  • Small practice tasks with a progress tracker.
  • Learning games for selected topics.
  • A certificate design linked to the learner’s skill and completion.

The website also provides a theme control for switching between light and dark appearance. Its navigation menu links the main pages so that visitors can move between sections.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

9. TECHNOLOGY USED

TechnologyUse in the project
HTML5Creates the structure and content of the website, including sections, forms, navigation and page elements.
CSS3Controls colours, typography, spacing, responsive layouts, cards, buttons and light/dark themes.
JavaScriptAdds interactions such as filtering, learning plans, admission form validation, games, search and page navigation.
Canvas APIUsed for drawing certificate previews in the browser.
Web StorageStores selected learning progress and project details locally in the browser.
Google FontsProvides the Outfit typeface used by the website design.

Data Handling and Scope

The current project is a front-end demonstration. Student records are sample data and admission applications are stored on the device. It does not include a server-side database, real online payment processing or a live certificate verification service.

Responsive Design

The layout uses flexible grids and mobile-specific styling so that course cards, forms and navigation can adapt to different screen sizes. The website also includes a print stylesheet that hides some interactive controls when a page is printed.

SKILLSPRINT | COLLEGE PROJECT REPORTSGAD College Government Tarntaran College

10. CONCLUSION

SkillSpark demonstrates how a website can organise beginner learning into a clear and manageable process. It brings course discovery, weekly plans, admission, learning games, student information and certificates together in one interface. The project uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript to provide an interactive experience that can be viewed on mobile and desktop devices.

Limitations

  • Data is stored in the browser and is not connected to a central server.
  • The student list contains sample records for demonstration.
  • Real online payment is not implemented.
  • Certificate verification is not connected to a live verification system.

Future Scope

  • Add user accounts and a secure database.
  • Integrate an online payment system.
  • Add video lessons and live classes.
  • Develop a mobile application and add more learning skills.
  • Add QR-code-based certificate verification.

References

  2. W3Schools – https://www.w3schools.com
  3. Google Fonts – https://fonts.google.com
